explanation: 0.1 and 0.2 have no exact binary representation, so their sum is very slightly off 0.3 and == is false. This is not a Java quirk - it is how binary floating point works everywhere. Compare the difference against a small tolerance instead: Math.abs(a - 0.3) < 1e-9.
hints: Can 0.1 be written exactly in binary?
